title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
lineage: MAC (Taped by Steven Martin, modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary

ai_review.summary: A hot Warfield show with a monster Scarlet > Fire, jazzy Estimated Prophet and funky Birdsong, captured on an audience tape that’s solid but a bit hissy.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as high‑energy and “rippin’,” highlighted by the opening Minglewood, a stellar Scarlet > Fire sequence, and a grooving Estimated Prophet. The audience recording is generally listenable with some amp‑hiss and occasional rough edges, but it doesn’t detract from the overall excitement of this 1982 Warfield night.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the musical performance (many 4‑5 star comments) and mostly positive remarks about the tape’s listenability despite minor hiss, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Solid audience tape with some amp‑hiss and occasional muffiness; listeners note it isn’t as clean as an SBD but remains enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, upbeat set that opens with Minglewood and flows through Sugaree into a jazzy second half; the energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for pulling out "The Tiger" during the space before The Wheel, a rare post‑1974 occurrence.
band_member_comments.Bob: His vocal “scatting” harmonizes with the guitar during Estimated Prophet, highlighted as a unique moment.
